svg.metadata: Target Mauritania geometry: ANSADE / UNOCHA Common Operational Dataset, Admin Level 0 international boundary, publication 2024-03-27, WGS84 / EPSG:4326. Western Sahara coastline and outer boundary remain the pinned Natural Earth 1:10m geometry unchanged. Only the shared Mauritania–Western Sahara land-border segment is unified; its endpoints are the original Western Sahara coastal junction and northeast junction, and its interior follows the ANSADE / UNOCHA Mauritania boundary. Other surrounding context: Natural Earth 1:10m Admin-0. The map does not express a position on disputed status. Bounds W -20 S 13 E -2 N 29.
